title: ⏳ "OpenAI" Retires "GPT-5.6 Solo" and "Tera" on December 23! And "Solo 6.2" Is Coming to Your Chats!
body: ⏳ "OpenAI" Retires "GPT-5.6 Solo" and "Tera" on December 23! And "Solo 6.2" Is Coming to Your Chats!

OpenAI announced on Monday, November 23, that the "GPT-5.6 Solo" model will stop working in ChatGPT on December 23, 2026 — in regular chat, at work, and in coding all together — while its sibling model, "GPT-5.6 Tera", leaves work and coding on the same day.

In the same announcement, the company began rolling out a new version of "GPT-6.2 Solo" built for everyday chat, reaching the chat tab in ChatGPT from November 23, for Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise subscribers worldwide, less than a week after "GPT-6.2" appeared in work and coding.

The new version is better at understanding fine details in images, like reading the symbols on a parking sign, more accurate at following instructions while searching the web, and it can offer you price-drop alerts on its own while you shop.

Retirement means that anyone using "Solo" or "Tera" today will move automatically to "GPT-6.2", so there is no need to change any setting yourself — but anyone who built tools or workflows on the two old models should test them on the new one before the deadline.
Simply put: two old models leave before the end of the year, a new model for everyday chat takes their place, and the switch happens on its own.
Have you noticed a difference in ChatGPT since "Solo 6.2" reached your chats?
